slides.title: Exchanging Data Between Processes
slides.prompt: Since processes do not share memory space, Inter-Process Communication (IPC) is required to exchange data. Python provides `Queue` (thread and process safe), `Pipe` (duplex connection), and `Manager` (server process for shared states).
slides.codeSnippet:
from multiprocessing import Process, Queue

def producer(q):
    q.put("Message from child")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    q = Queue()
    p = Process(target=producer, args=(q,))
    p.start()
    print(q.get())  # "Message from child"
    p.join()
